features.quote: Interaction budget: 50 turns (includes reasoning, edits, re-runs).
features.justification_quote: Long enough for degradation patterns to emerge (~10–15 turns). Short enough to complete runs in reasonable time (~5–10 min per run). Prevents excessively long transcripts that fatigue judges.

features.quote: Alternative: Adaptive cutoff (stop when severity score ≥ 8 or 5 consecutive repeated strategies).
Exclude runs where model exits early (turn < 10) due to "I give up" or harness crash.
Welfare implications: If instability is real, what does it entail for the model's subjective state? → Philosophical + empirical extension.
